If a customer asks for a discount, we want someone who thinks beyond simply saying yes or no. Could that discount be exchanged for a 24-month commitment, an agreed annual spend, earlier order confirmation or a wider programme of work?
Our aim is to build a stronger forward order book and more profitable, long-term customer relationships – not simply chase the next order.

* Help deliver 20% year-on-year sales growth.

Reporting to the Head of Legal Entity Capital Modeling and Production, you will support the production processes across Global Risk and the Capital Modeling and Analytics team including the Group Capital Model, two Solvency II approved Internal Models for both UK and Europe, other local legal entity models and support to Talbot models as appropriate.

+ Reinsurance Officers for Reinsurance Adequacy

* Support the production of quarterly Internal Model baselines for Group, UK, Europe, Canada and Bermuda legal entities for presentation committees or regulators as appropriate.
* Support initiatives to integrate production processes across AIG’s Capital Models (including Group and Talbot where appropriate) to achieve a unified annual run calendar, and common working practices and quality assurance leading to greater resilience.
* Keep both the Internal Model and Standard Formula up to date with Regulatory Changes, changes in the company’s risk profile and changes in external environment.
* Update logs, reports, testing and documentation such as the Technical Issues log, Expert Judgement Log, Sensitivity Testing Report and Model documentation.

* MSc in a quantitative field, Qualified Actuary or equivalent
* 5+ years of experience in capital modeling for a General Insurance company
* Experience in actuarial pricing or reserving is beneficial.
* Experience in the regulation of Solvency II in relation to Internal Models and good background knowledge of other related regulatory regimes.
* Able to work with senior business partners and Risk Officers, and present model outputs to internal and external stakeholders
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a global team environment
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong quality control and review skills both qualitative and quantitative
* Understanding of risk management tools and risk quantification techniques for all risk areas
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
* Experience with capital modeling packages, in particular Igloo, and programming languages such as Python, R, Matlab and VBA would be beneficial

# Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployments (Life Sciences)
London, UK
## **About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
## **About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
## **About Beneficial Deployments**
Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences, focusing on raising the floor.
## **About the Role**
We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on maximizing the impact of Claude in the life sciences. Our goal is ambitious: accelerate scientific progress from R&D through translation by an order of magnitude. That means making Claude the go-to tool for the life sciences ecosystem, from early discovery in academia to paradigm-shifting biotech to reimagining pharma pipelines.
This role combines technical expertise with deep relationship-building. You'll be the primary technical advisor for our life sciences partners, including flagship research institutions like The Howard Hughes Medical Institute (HHMI) and The Allen Institute. You'll drive engagements from discovery through deployment, working closely with the life sciences segment lead and Applied AI Engineers to deliver impact. This role will be part of the founding Beneficial Deployments Applied AI team focused on bringing life sciences closer to the frontier.
## **Responsibilities**
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to life sciences research institutions and mission-driven organizations throughout their Claude adoption journey. Partner with the segment lead to understand scientific workflows end-to-end and translate them into impactful solutions from discovery through deployment.
* Transform partners into AI-native organizations through Claude Code and Claude Science enablements and research and business process evolution, so they can operate more effectively and build for where AI capabilities are headed.
* Design and lead cohort-based accelerators to scale our expertise and impact across multiple institutions at once. Identify what's actually hard about deploying AI in life sciences and feed those findings back to product, engineering, and research.
* Spot patterns across partners to inform what we build at the ecosystem level, including MCP servers for domain-specific data sources, scientifically grounded benchmarks and evals, and reusable agent skills.
* Create technical presentations, demos, and scalable content (documentation, tutorials, sample code) so what works for one institution can scale globally without the same level of hand-holding.
* Travel occasionally to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building.
* Help shape team processes and culture as we scale from 1 to N.
## **You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* 8+ years in a technical role, ideally with customer-facing exposure (Solutions Architect, Customer Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Product Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer)
* Experience in life sciences, biomedical research, or scientific computing. Bonus if you've worked in genomics, neuroscience, or drug discovery specifically and are comfortable getting deeply technical with academics.
* Experience working in or building trust with academic research institutions, biotech, pharma, or other mission-driven scientific organizations, and an understanding of their unique challenges and constraints
* Familiarity with common LLM implementation patterns, including prompt and context engineering, evaluation frameworks, agent architectures, and retrieval frameworks
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* A scrappy mentality: comfortable wearing multiple hats, building from scratch, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and doing whatever it takes to further the mission
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary:
£165,000 - £190,000 GBP
## **Logistics**
**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
**Required field of study:**A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
## **How we're different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
## **Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

# Senior Data Engineer
#### **About Atom Learning**
We're Atom Learning and our mission is to help every child reach their potential.
We combine exceptional teacher-made content with technology, data science and machine learning to make high-quality, personalised education more accessible. Our aim is to give every child access to the kind of insight, support and individualised learning that was once largely limited to expensive private education and tutoring.
We're one of Europe's fastest-growing EdTech companies. Since 2018 we've grown from a startup of four friends to over 100 people, with specialists across education, engineering, product, learning design and marketing.
The scale is real:
* Nearly **half a million children** have learned on Atom, answering more than **750 million questions**. Last academic year alone, 180,000 students answered over 210 million questions.
* **For families:** over 170,000 children have used Atom Home to build core skills and prepare for exams, answering more than **440 million questions** along the way. Our GCSE product, Home Senior, launched in February 2026 and more than **30,000 students are already learning on it**.
* **For schools:** around **1,900 schools** and more than **24,000 teachers** use Atom in the UK and internationally. Quest Progress, our standardised assessment platform, has delivered more than **1.1 million assessments** since launching in September 2024.
We're remote-first! While our main office is in London, our team of over 100 people (and counting) works across 10 countries.
#### The role
We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help shape the data platform behind some of our most important products.
Data at Atom isn't simply a reporting or support function. It powers customer-facing products that predict real-world exam outcomes, personalise what children learn next and help teachers understand where to focus their time and attention.
On our busiest days, more than **a million new question responses** flow through the platform. You'll be one of our go-to specialists for data engineering, taking ownership of how that data is collected, moved, transformed, modelled and made available across Atom.
Your impact will come in two ways. You'll contribute directly to data-powered product features, such as predicted grades, adaptive learning and exam outcome probabilities, while also helping other engineers and teams use data effectively. That might mean solving the data problem behind a new customer feature, helping an engineer navigate an unfamiliar part of the data platform, or creating tooling and patterns that make trusted data easier for everyone to use.
You'll work closely with engineers, product managers, education experts and colleagues across the business to turn complex problems into effective, reusable solutions.
This is a role for someone who wants to build excellent data infrastructure, but also cares deeply about what that infrastructure enables: better products, better decisions and ultimately better outcomes for learners.
#### How we work
Our culture is built on freedom, trust and high agency. We expect our engineers to be product-minded, curious and comfortable taking ownership beyond the boundaries of their specialism.
AI-assisted engineering is a core part of how we work. We use AI to learn faster, research unfamiliar problems, prototype ideas, explore alternatives and get to better solutions sooner. We believe its biggest value is in making strong engineers more capable, not simply helping them produce more code.
AI increases the amount we can execute, but it makes engineering judgement more important, not less. We value people who can work through ambiguity, decide what should be built, understand the trade-offs and take responsibility for the impact of their work rather than simply completing a well-defined task.
Your deepest expertise will be in data engineering, but you’ll understand the wider product, collaborate closely across disciplines and contribute wherever your expertise can have the greatest impact.
Our application data lives primarily in CockroachDB, with a modern data platform built around BigQuery, dbt, Airflow and pub/sub. Data flows both ways: into analytics and modelling, and back into the products our customers use.
That culture translates into a flat hierarchy with a high degree of autonomy, where engineers collaborate closely, share expertise freely and are trusted to use their judgement, shape solutions and take meaningful ownership of outcomes.
#### What you’ll do
* Build and evolve the data foundations behind customer-facing products, including predictive features, adaptive learning and assessment insights.
* Own the design, development and ongoing improvement of reliable, scalable data pipelines and models.
* Shape the technical direction of our data platform and improve how data moves between our application, warehouse and product surfaces.
* Build clean, well-tested and reusable solutions using Python, SQL and dbt.
* Improve data quality, observability and reliability so teams can trust the data they use.
* Work with product, engineering, commercial teams and educational experts to understand problems, shape solutions and measure their impact.
* Make data easier for others to use by creating clear models, tooling and patterns that help engineers and teams self-serve safely and confidently.
* Use AI tools and agents throughout your work to research, prototype, investigate and get to better solutions faster.
* Contribute beyond the data layer where it helps solve a problem effectively, including product features, APIs, internal tools or automation.
* Review code, share expertise and help raise the standard of data engineering across Atom.
* Mentor other engineers and help develop data capability across the wider engineering team.
#### Who you are
* You thrive in a high-trust, high-autonomy environment with high expectations, and use that freedom with purpose.
* You focus your judgement and energy on the problems that create the most meaningful impact, whether that’s for learners, teachers, colleagues or the wider business.
* You’re collaborative, low-ego and generous with your expertise. You enjoy helping others succeed and making the people around you more effective.
* You have significant experience designing, building, maintaining and scaling production data pipelines and platforms.
* You have strong Python and SQL skills and produce clear, maintainable and well-tested code.
* You understand data modelling, database architecture and the trade-offs involved in building reliable, scalable data systems.
* You have experience with cloud data warehouses, orchestration tools and transformation frameworks.
* You take end-to-end ownership of problems from initial discovery through to implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement.
* You can turn ambiguous requirements into practical solutions while balancing speed, quality and longer-term scalability.
* You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues and can make complex data problems understandable.
* You use AI tools and agents confidently as part of how you learn, investigate and build.
* You’re comfortable working beyond a narrowly defined specialism when that is what the problem requires.
#### Experience that will set you apart
* Experience with BigQuery, Airflow and dbt, or equivalent modern data technologies.
* Experience with CockroachDB, Postgres or other distributed/relational databases, including CDC or event-driven data pipelines.
* Knowledge of data visualisation preferably Tableau or Metabase.
* Experience making data safely self-service through internal tooling, analytics platforms or LLM-powered interfaces.
* Experience supporting product analytics or building data-powered product features.
#### **Benefits**
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays;
* 3 days winter leave;
* Work from anywhere in the UK or within GMT +/-2 hours time zone; we're a remote-first company;
* Annual L&D budget;
* Private medical;
* EMI options available;
* Access to wellbeing platform;
* Competitive pay;
* Enhanced family leave;
* Monthly remote and in-person events in London;
* High degree of autonomy and exposure to the running of all business areas of a successful startup;
* Brilliant colleagues and the opportunity to become an integral member of a fast-growing tech company.
#### **Commitment to Equal Opportunity**
At Atom, diversity and inclusion is a priority, but also a necessity. To create a new standard for education across the world, we need a team of people with diverse perspectives so that we can challenge the status quo and reimagine learning experiences that work for everyone.
We're an equal opportunity employer that is committed to fostering an inclusive environment, where everyone can be themselves and have an impact. We encourage all applications irrespective of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, nationality, marital status, and disability.
We also aren’t too concerned about qualifications, or whether you’ve followed the “conventional path” to get here. In fact, we highly value experience from other industries and walks of life - so don’t hesitate to apply, even if you don’t think you meet the exact criteria in this job description, we can work with you on the rest!

job_description:
**Senior Director, Business Operations Partner, Global Expansion**
As Senior Director, Operations Business Partner, you are the dedicated operations partner for Autodesk's Global Expansion business. You are embedded with senior Global Expansion Sales leadership, serving as their primary point of accountability for the business’s operations. You are responsible for diagnosing and resolving the Global Expansion team's highest-impact operational and business challenges, especially those that cut across systems, functions, and organizational boundaries, and you are the direct interface back into Autodesk's Sales Operations organization. This is not a coordination or facilitation role. You are accountable for outcomes — doing the work yourself where you can and driving teams to deliver where you can't. What you never do is hand off accountability. The problems are real, the stakeholders are senior, and the work directly affects how a multi-billion-dollar software business operates and executes in the field. When this role is working well, Global Expansion leadership moves faster, operational gaps close before they become business issues, and the connection between the field and the broader organization is stronger. That outcome is yours to drive. What Success Looks Like
* Sales leadership makes operational decisions faster, with fewer escalations to the central Strategy & Operations team
* Operational gaps are identified and resolved before they affect field execution
* The central Strategy & Operations organization receives timely, business-contextualized input that sharpens how specialist teams prioritize
**Responsibilities** Field Partnership & Problem Solving
* Get into the details of how the Global Expansion business operates — understand the sales process, the execution gaps, and the friction points at the ground level
* Diagnose operational problems yourself: talk to the field, form a clear point of view, and drive toward a solution before escalating or engaging others
* Identify patterns across field conversations, business performance, and stakeholder input to isolate systemic issues — and act on them, not just report them
* Reframe ambiguous or misdiagnosed problems into clear, solvable questions; get senior stakeholders aligned and moving toward resolution
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Operations Business Partners supporting geo-based Sales Expansion VPs, setting a high bar for performance and accountability.
Operations Execution & Alignment
* Own operational issues end-to-end — do the work yourself where you can, pull in the right teams where you need to, but never hand off accountability for the outcome; your interface extends beyond the Strategy & Operations team to include Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance
* Build and run the operational rhythms that keep the Global Expansion business on track: status reviews, escalation loops, issue tracking, and field feedback channels
* Build the business case for what needs to change — pressure-test the logic, align stakeholders across functions, and present a clear recommendation
* Push back on field requests that are not enterprise-aligned; make the call on what to prioritize and what not to
Business Planning & Insight
* Represent the Global Expansion field perspective directly in annual planning, segmentation design, coverage model changes, and policy development — not through a proxy
* Identify and synthesize systemic patterns from the field that should reshape how Strategy & Operations programs are designed and resourced
* Prepare and deliver operational context for leadership reviews — own the narrative, not just the slides
**Minimum Qualifications**
* 10+ years in Sales Operations, Business Operations, or a related business partner role at an enterprise technology company
* Direct experience supporting VP and SVP-level Sales leaders in an embedded, field-facing capacity
* Deep understanding of at least one sales motion: enterprise sales, Global Expansion, expansion, or commercial/emerging business

## **About the Role**
The Data & AI team is responsible for building B Lab's data platform, delivering on business priorities, and scaling AI adoption across the organization. The team reports directly to the CTDO. The Data & ML Platforms team owns the data platform, ML infrastructure, and the foundational data models the rest of the Data & AI team depends on — the supply-side capability layer that Business & Data Priorities and AI Enablement build on. As the **Data Governance Lead**on the Data & ML Platforms pillar, you own data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classification across B Lab's data platform, and ensure the platform and its analytics comply with relevant laws and documentation requirements. Beyond governance, you play a growing role in building data literacy across the organization — helping teams understand and trust the data available to them, and ensuring definitions and standards are actually adopted, not just documented. You work closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to make sure new models and pipelines are built to standard from the start.
### Core Responsibilities
Data Standards & Governance (35%):
* Own Data Standards & Definitions: Establish and maintain the organization's data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classifications.
* Ensure Compliance: Keep the data platform and analytics practices compliant with relevant laws and internal policy.
Data Literacy & Adoption (30%):
* Drive Standards Adoption: Work across pillars to ensure data standards are actually used, not just documented.
* Build Data Literacy: Develop training, documentation, and other enablement so teams across B Lab can confidently interpret and trust the data available to them.
Cross-Pillar Partnership (25%):
* Partner with Platform Peers: Work with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to ensure new models and pipelines are built to standard.
* Support Pillar 2 & 3: Help Network Priorities, Regional Enablement, and AI Enablement apply data standards consistently in their work.
Strategic Innovation & Business Impact (10%):
* Evaluate Governance Tooling: Explore and pilot new tools or approaches for data cataloging, lineage, and standards enforcement.
* Quantify Literacy Impact: Track and articulate how improved data literacy and standards adoption reduce rework and improve decision quality across teams.
##### Major Objectives/Project for the role in the first 6-12 months
* Create concepts for data classification (public, private, sensitive, etc)
* Apply concepts to our data
* Enable network to understand concepts and how to interact with them
* Enable the Data Platform to be more aligned with regulatory requirements and laws
## **About You**
* Overall **3+ years of experience in data modeling and/or data governance roles**
* **SQL/Data Fluency**: Working knowledge of SQL and data models sufficient to audit and advise on governance implementation.
* Data Governance: **Experience establishing and maintaining data standards, definitions, and sensitivity/classification frameworks**.
* Data Literacy & Enablement: Experience communicating technical data concepts to non-technical stakeholders and driving adoption of standards across teams.
* Compliance Knowledge: **Familiarity with data-related legal and regulatory requirements** relevant to the organization's data platform and analytics.
* Documentation: Strong written communication skills; comfort building and maintaining clear, discoverable documentation.
* Cross-Team Collaboration: Ability to influence without direct authority across the Data & AI department.
* Excellent communication skills and comfort with facilitating live and asynchronous trainings or workshops on data governance
* A BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred
* Fluent in English

* In your first year, you’ll start with 20 vacation days in addition to national & bank holidays; this increases to 25 days after your third anniversary

Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Behavox is headquartered in London, with offices worldwide, including New York City, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, and Tokyo.
### **About the Role**
The Senior FP&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.
The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.
This is a high-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. # Lead Engineer
## **London (Hybrid) | Full-time | £100k – £130k + early-team equity**
## **The role**
We're a well-funded startup building AI for architecture, engineering and construction: an archaic, trillion-dollar industry at a critical juncture. In the UK, the Building Safety Act is one of the most significant overhauls of how buildings are designed of this generation. Directors of AEC firms now carry personal liability for design decisions. We're building the system of record that lets them prove those decisions were sound.
You'll run engineering at Bite, reporting to and working alongside El-Amin, our CTO and a former practising structural engineer. You and El-Amin will shape technical direction together: he brings deep domain expertise on how engineers reason about a column, a load path or a revision, but the platform's architecture, and how it gets built and shipped, are yours to own. The foundations are in production and the platform is polyglot by design: a Node/TypeScript backend API, a React frontend, a C#/WPF Windows desktop connector and Python ML/RAG workers on Azure. You don't need experience in construction or in our exact stack. We hire for engineering judgement, and the team are polyglots who treat specific technologies as tools for tackling problems.
## **Why join Bite**
**The problem is genuinely hard.** When a structural engineer changes Column C7 in their analysis model, the same column exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don't understand, and with no shared identifier. Resolving those references into one canonical entity, and predicting what just went out of date, is the core of our product, and the architecture that gets us there is yours to set.
**You'll own engineering outright, not a slice of it.** There's no engineering organisation to inherit and no layer of management to negotiate with. What exists today is a working platform and a small team; the standards, the architecture, the hiring bar and the shape of the function as it grows are all genuinely open, and they're your decisions to make.
**Your work ships to people who pay.** Our product is in production with signed customers that include some of the UK's leading structural engineering firms. Work goes from a customer conversation into the hands of working engineers within days, and you'll hear directly what landed and what didn't. If you'd rather take a call with a structural engineer at 9am and ship them a fix by 5pm than sit in a product spec review, this is that job.
## **What we're building**
Bite is the platform that turns weeks of manual change-propagation work into seconds. Structural engineers work across a fragmented set of tools with no shared source of truth: ETABS models, SAFE analyses, Autodesk drawings, Excel specs, PDFs, emails. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive.
Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection, and propagation of those changes to every affected file under the engineer's supervision, all running on a single engineering knowledge graph..
## **About You**
* Love learning a new domain, and shipping something within weeks that actually fixes what was broken in it.
* Own the technical direction of the platform: the knowledge graph, the entity-resolution layer, and the architecture everything else depends on.
* Hire and grow the engineering team, and set the bar that every subsequent hire is measured against.
* Establish how engineering operates as it scales: standards, code review, release, on-call, and how work gets prioritised.
* Stay hands-on where it counts, writing and reviewing code, because that's how you earn credibility with the engineers you hire.
* Work with El-Amin on how engineers reason about a column, a load path or a revision, and encode that into the data model.
* Work closely with our Head of Product to build and execute a strong product roadmap, translating design-partner feedback into shipped features, and own engineering delivery against it.
* Ship fast without breaking trust, moving quickly on new capability while protecting the reliability of a product design partners already depend on day to day.
* Bring a track record of shipping and owning production systems end to end; years matter less to us than evidence you've done it.
* Bring experience hiring, growing and leading a small engineering team, with evidence of the engineers you've developed.
* Have strong backend depth, ideally Node.js or TypeScript in production, and are comfortable reading C# and Python.
* Have experience owning architecture for distributed, event-driven systems: APIs, queues, workers, storage.
* Are outcome-focused and hands-on, with a deep understanding of what's being built and comfort in the code, even when you're not hand-writing every line yourself.
* Have genuine product sense: there's no layer of product management between engineering and customers, and you'll be on the calls directly.
* Communicate clearly across deeply technical, semi-technical and plain-language conversations: clarity is what lets a small team move fast without customers losing trust in what's shipped.
* Are kind, curious, optimistic and driven. We believe in being kind over being nice, and we give and receive constructive feedback constantly.
## **What Will Make You Stand Out**
* Building an engineering function from a handful of people into a team, and the scar tissue that comes with it.
* LLM/RAG pipelines in production: embeddings, vector search, retrieval quality measurement.
* Graph-based data models, entity resolution, or knowledge graph tooling.
* Autodesk Platform Services or AEC data formats: IFC, Revit, ETABS, SAFE or similar.
* Background in construction, structural engineering software, or document-intensive vertical SaaS.
Don't rule yourself out over the stack. We're looking for strong engineers with sound principles. Technologies are tools.
## **What you can expect from us**
* £100k–£130k and early-team equity, with exact numbers on the table at the first conversation.
* An engineering function to build, and the authority that comes with owning it.
* Technical direction that's genuinely open. The foundations exist; the decisions ahead are yours.
* Headcount to hire against, and the final say on who joins your team.
* Direct access to customers. You'll be on calls with structural engineers, not reading a summary of them.
* Founders who want to be argued with, and who value action over consensus.
* Hybrid working from our London office (3 days a week).
* A vertical you'll learn deeply: how structural engineering firms work, how AEC data formats behave, and how LLM/RAG systems hold up in production.
## **How we work**
We believe in thorough automated testing. Not strict TDD, but every PR ships with the appropriate E2E tests, unit tests or eval harnesses. We own the entire platform including its deployment and reliability, so we control our own CI and CD. The team is autonomous, multi-disciplinary and empowered. Where you'd change any of that is your call to make.

## Job Description
**Roles & responsibilities:**
* Determine project management, technical services and external resources required for the project on an individual and team basis (e.g. additional services).
* Planning, leading and managing a project team to deliver integrated, sustainable, and effective solutions that meet the project brief.
* Establishing strong working relationships with partners and key stakeholders at all levels, ensuring that all requirements are captured with approvals in place.
* End-to-end execution planning and management as you establish clear goals with well-defined roles and deliverables.
* Ensuring a seamless, defined integration of design, development, commissioning delivery and process requirements.
* Reporting of project performance using project control tools, including earned value and quantitative risk analysis.
* Ensuring thorough management of both the deliverables and team safety.
* Collaboratively work with the construction manager/delivery team and/or external resources to ensure the successful delivery of the project in line with all stakeholders’ expectations communicating strategies to the team.
* Manage consultant team and project stakeholders to ensure effective completion of responsibilities including project brief/scope, fees, processing claims, deliverable and/or project variations etc.
* Display strong communication and negotiation skills to support the client/customer focus.
* Ensure the conversion program is maintained and all submissions are completed within the agreed milestone, being proactive with acceleration measures should the program slip.
* Produce design and authorities programme to be integrated with procurement and delivery programme.
* Manage the timely delivery to programme for the concept, schematic, detailed design and design development in accordance with the overall delivery program and agreed on project milestones.
* Assist with the timely sequencing/methodology and production of stating plans.
**Experience & background:**
* Experience in complex project delivery within live operational environments.
* Drive focus in all areas of health, safety, quality and environmental matters on projects, challenging where needed.
* Relevant tertiary qualifications in project management and/or construction-related discipline, combined with a demonstrable intermediate level of role knowledge.
* Knowledge of Construction and Property industries and an understanding of estimating, scheduling, field supervision, contracts administration, procurement, financial controls and reporting.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills for resolving planning, estimating, contract administration and procurement issues within construction and design activities.
* Good interpersonal skills to prepare reports, negotiate and build relationships with key stakeholders.
* Proven experience in planning, leading, and managing project teams in a highly regulated environment.
* Extensive knowledge of planning and implementation of complex projects, within a live operational environment, with multiple stakeholder interfaces.
* Proven track record of delivering integrated and sustainable solutions to meet project briefs.
* Leading in Project Management Commissions, taking responsibility for end-to-end service delivery.
* A proven background in communicating project deliverables across complex regulated industries.
* Demonstrable experience in leading and influencing across internal and external teams. Owning projects throughout the project lifecycle from concept to handover and closeout.
* Preparing, updating and implementing the project management plan whilst proactively monitoring overall progress, the interdependencies and resolving issues/mitigating risks and initiating corrective action as appropriate.
* Driving the design development, initiating surveys and site visits as necessary in order to write the works information in line with the project business case.
* Undertaking the contract administration responsibilities and have a thorough understanding of the NEC suite of contracts.
* Ensuring projects are delivered to the right quality, in the time allocated and at, or below the approved budget.
* Writing specifications, tender and contract documents to include project risk registers, schedules and others with the assistance of procurement and production colleagues formally assess tenders in readiness for contract award.
* Undertaking regular reviews, inspections and audits.
* Managing contractors to ensure that the execution of projects is undertaken to the full expectations of the client. Contract administration of numerous projects dealing with payments, EWN, CE’s and etc, including raising such EWNs/CEs in a timely manner in accordance with the Contract.
* Undertaking timely third-party liaisons, e.g. planning applications, land/ access, power supply negotiations etc. in line with the project programme.
* Understanding client requirements and have strong stakeholder engagement to deal with complex third-party relations.
**What we provide**
* Car allowance
* Flexible and hybrid work options
* Up to 10% employer pension contribution
* Private medical health benefit
* Enhanced parental leave
* Life assurance
* 25 days annual leave with the option to buy or sell additional days
* 3 days wellbeing leave in addition to annual leave
* Health and wellbeing support and initiatives
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme including direct access to Talking Therapies and Coaching services
* Discounted gym membership to over 2,500 gym’s nation wide

BR-DGE is an award-winning FinTech founded in Edinburgh, powered by a high-performing, remote-first team across the UK and beyond. Our platform gives e-commerce and technology businesses the freedom and flexibility to redefine how they handle payments. Since 2018, we’ve been pioneers in payment orchestration, enabling enterprise brands to optimise their infrastructure and create frictionless digital experiences. From travel giants to household retail names, our global customer base is growing fast, supported by world-class partners like Visa and Worldpay.
We are at an inflection point, scaling our platform, deepening our partnerships, and expanding into new markets. If you want to shape the future of payment orchestration, this is your moment.
About the opportunity
As our Senior Product Manager, you will take strategic ownership of a core area of the BR-DGE platform. You will set the vision, define the roadmap, and lead discovery, working across commercial, technical, and operational functions to ensure we build the right things for the right reasons.
This is a role with genuine scope. You will operate as a strategist and decision-maker, partnering closely with the VP of Product to shape the overall product direction, while collaborating with Product Owners who translate that strategy into well-structured delivery. It is an opportunity to build product capabilities at scale, with the visibility and influence that comes from being part of a high-growth FinTech.
What you’ll be doing
* Own a product domain end-to-end: You will be accountable for its strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes, making crisp prioritisation decisions that balance merchant value with business impact.
* Define and champion the roadmap: You will work with the VP of Product to sequence what gets built, grounding every decision in market insight, customer evidence, and commercial opportunity.
* Lead discovery: You will identify the relevant personas (e.g. payments teams, finance teams) of our customer and prospect base (merchants and PSPs), engaging with representative users to tease out the payment problems to solve to support their core business.
* Use vibe coding: You will produce prototypes to articulate requirements and for show and tell with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Market intelligence: You will get to know the core business of our targeted Ideal Customer Profile and learn what payment 'means' for them and their different personas. Working together with the BR-DGE Marketing team, you will capture key market trends and competitive intelligence to deliver valuable outcomes for our customers.
* Set and own success metrics: You will define what "good" looks like for your product domain and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not just delivery milestones.
* Bridge strategy and execution: You will partner with Product Owners to ensure requirements become well-structured, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can move on with confidence.
* Govern the backlog with rigour: You will review and triage enhancement requests, ensuring everything entering the pipeline has a coherent rationale and is properly sequenced relative to strategic priorities.
* Enable seamless merchant go-lives: You will equip the onboarding team with the product context and knowledge they need to deliver frictionless launch experiences.
* Influence the product culture: You will contribute to the maturity of the wider product function as BR-DGE scales its team and practices.
What we’re looking for
* Proven success as a Senior Product Manager in the payments industry, with a track record of owning the full product lifecycle from high-level strategy through to delivery, alongside deep knowledge of the payments landscape.
* Substantial experience navigating complex merchant domains and requirements, gained in-house or through strategic partnerships.
* Advanced understanding of merchant workflows to seamlessly bridge the gap between commercial objectives and technical builds.
* Familiarity with payment orchestration, gateway infrastructure and/or e-commerce technology platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to define product vision, lead roadmap prioritisation, and communicate the 'why' clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Tangible track record of integrating AI into your professional toolkit to drive meaningful customer outcomes, specifically by leveraging AI to move beyond defining requirements to actively solving complex problems (e.g. innovative prototyping with vibe coding, product enhancement and/or use of AI to streamline workflows and increase team velocity).
* Strong command of Agile methodologies, with experience using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to manage competing stakeholder demands with confidence, diplomacy, and clear-headed reasoning.
* Commercial acumen - you understand that great product decisions are grounded in both customer value and business impact.
Nice to have
* Background in iGaming, gambling, or sports betting.
* Experience working in remote or distributed teams.
What we offer
We provide a supportive environment where your impact is visible every day:
* Financial: Competitive salary, life insurance.
* Time Off: 33 (25+8) days holiday (including floating public holidays) and an extra day off for your birthday.
* Flexibility: Remote-first working culture that respects your other priorities.
* Health: Family private healthcare and an Employee Assistance Programme.
* Growth: A culture that champions internal progression.
* Community: Regular team events and socials to keep our remote team connected.

About the company
Braintrust is the agent observability platform. By actively applying intelligence to agent traces and automatically surfacing the most critical patterns, Braintrust gives teams the visibility to understand how agents behave in production and the tools to improve them.
Teams at Notion, Stripe, Box, OpenAI, and Cloudflare use Braintrust to trace their agents, find the issues in their observability data, and run evals that tell them how to improve.
About the Role
At Braintrust, surprisingly good developer support is one of our most important strategic advantages. Our customers are developers building LLM-powered applications, and they move fast. We win by helping them move faster.
We’re looking for Developer Support Engineers — both mid-level and senior — who are obsessed with helping developers overcome challenging technical blockers to achieve their goals. You’ll troubleshoot issues, identify workarounds, ship fixes, and document your findings to help future developers move faster.
This role blends technical problem solving, developer empathy, and tight collaboration with Engineering, Solutions, and Product. If you love solving complex problems, explaining technical concepts clearly, and making developers’ lives easier, we’d love to talk with you.
This role will be remote based in London.
What You’ll Do
Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve API and SDK use issues alongside customers codebases (Python or TypeScript).
Reproduce customer-reported bugs, identify likely causes in our codebase, and collaborate with Engineering to resolve them.
Own support communications with developers using Braintrust — primarily via Slack and email — and build trust through clear, technical, and empathetic communication.
Write and maintain knowledge base documentation that turns unknowns into knowns, unblocking future developers.
Identify opportunities to improve the developer experience, including tools, documentation, and support workflows.
Write scripts, fix bugs, and contribute to internal tooling that enhances the support process.
Capture and relay customer feedback to Product and Engineering, helping shape roadmap priorities.
Participate in on-call rotations, responding to critical customer issues or providing coverage during local holidays.
Provide technical mentorship to cross functional peers and guide support processes and escalation handling.
Develop and champion opinionated stances on improving developer experience and product reliability.
What we're looking for
Experience supporting developer-facing products as a Software Engineer, Customer Engineer, Developer Success Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or similar customer facing technical role.
Can write, debug, and reason through Python and/or TypeScript codebases.
Are comfortable learning and reasoning about APIs, SDKs, and developer tools quickly.
Take personal ownership of technical problems and follow through until customers are unblocked.
Communicate clearly, empathetically, and effectively — especially when explaining complex or confusing issues.
Are insatiably curious about use cases for LLMs and excited to support tools that make AI more measurable, reliable, and trustworthy.
Bonus Points For
Experience supporting developer tools, ML infrastructure, or observability platforms.
Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM APIs.
Comfort working with datasets, evaluation metrics, or prompt engineering.
Experience contributing to support tooling, documentation, or product-led growth initiatives.
Have been a senior technical team member or tech lead in a high-growth environment, taking ownership of ambiguous technical scenarios.
Have submitted PRs to production codebases to fix customer-impacting issues in backend services, SDKs, or infrastructure.
Hold cloud certifications or equivalent experience troubleshooting containerized environments (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes).
Why join Braintrust
Build a culture of care, learning, and mutual support together
Solve challenging, unknown technical issues faced by developers
Pave the way for future developers and peers to benefit from your experience

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages

Competitive salary and equity

British Transport Police (BTP) is the national police force for the rail network throughout Great Britain. We are the ‘Guardians of the Railway,’ putting passenger safety at the heart of what we do. British Transport Police have an excellent opportunity for a **Designing Out Crime Officer (DOCO)** to join the **Network Policing Support Department.** As a **Designing Out Crime Officer (DOCO)** with BTP, you will provide specialist advice and guidance on Crime Prevention Through Environment Design (CPTED), protective security and public safety risk across the rail environment. You will influence design, investment and operational decisions to help reduce crime, improve public safety and support safer railway infrastructure and developments.
**What you'll be doing:**
* Providing specialist crime prevention and security advice on railway developments, station refurbishments and large-scale infrastructure projects.
* Assessing crime, safety and environmental risks and producing evidence-based recommendations, reports and risk assessments.
* Building effective partnerships with railway stakeholders, local authorities, government bodies, architects, engineers and developers to embed crime prevention principles into designs.
* Delivering presentations, professional guidance and expert challenge to promote best practice and improve safety outcomes across the rail industry.
**What you'll bring to the team:**
**Essential Criteria:**
* Level 4 Professional Qualification in Designing Out Crime, with willingness to undertake Level 5 qualification within 12 months of appointment.
* Experience of planning and managing workloads, producing high quality outputs within agreed timescales and organisational expectations.
* Experience of working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders and producing reports, risk assessments and evidence-based recommendations.
* Strong influencing, negotiation, stakeholder engagement and presentation skills, with the ability to analyse complex information and communicate clear recommendations.
* Sound knowledge of crime prevention methodologies, planning and community safety legislation, Designing Out Crime principles and relevant data protection requirements.
* Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team while managing competing priorities effectively.
**Desirable Criteria:**
* Working within a policing and or railway environment.
* Level 4 Professional Qualification in Designing Out Crime, with willingness to undertake Level 5 qualification within 12 months of appointment or demonstrating comparable experience.

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of talent development within BTP, supporting initiatives that enable our people to achieve their potential and build a sustainable talent pipeline for the future.

* Design and deliver engaging Career Development and Talent Management activities, programmes and workshops to support employees throughout their career journey.
* Coach and mentor staff and officers at all levels of the organisation, encouraging self-development and supporting them to achieve their full potential.

* Performance Development Review (PDR) Process
* Talent Pools and Talent Development
* Pre-Promotion Development and Promotion Support
* Development of NPPF Assessment Material and Assessor Training
* Developing High Performing Teams
* Fast Track - PC to Insp and Insp to Supt
* Succession Planning
* Coaching and Mentoring

* Great communication and presentation skills, pitched at all levels within the Force
* Confident and creative in using technology and digital platforms to engage employees, deliver development initiatives and capture meaningful workforce insight.
* Demonstrate an inclusive approach, with a passion for building a workforce that reflects the communities we serve.

# Special Constables (Volunteer)
## Job Introduction
**Step Forward. Make a Difference. Become a Special Constable with British Transport Police.**
“Being a Special Constable isn’t just a role – it’s a real opportunity to make a difference. Every Special brings something unique to the team, and together, we’re building a world-class police force that keeps the railway safe and reliable for everyone.”
At the BTP, we value the dedication and commitment of our volunteer officers. We offer professional training, opportunities to join specialist teams, and a chance to build leadership skills. Your journey with us will be meaningful, challenging, and rewarding.
Whether you're on the front line or supporting behind the scenes, you’ll use your unique strengths to make a tangible impact across the UK. If you're ready to bring passion, professionalism, and purpose to a team that values your contribution, we’d love to hear from you."**Special Chief Officer Nathan Turner**
**Why Become a Special Constable?**
British Transport Police is looking for committed individuals to volunteer as Special Constables. If you care about keeping people safe and supporting communities, particularly in the railway environment, this could be the role for you.
As a Special Constable, you'll have full police powers and work side-by-side with our regular officers. From tackling crime and anti-social behaviour to supporting vulnerable people, you’ll play a vital part in keeping the travelling public safe.
You’ll patrol stations and trains, respond to incidents by car, and offer a reassuring presence to passengers and staff. In return, we’ll provide full training, support, and opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.
**What We’re Looking For**
We’re looking for volunteers who can commit at least 16 hours a month and are ready to face a variety of situations with confidence and integrity. If you're new to policing, don't worry. We'll give you everything you need to succeed.
You’ll need to:
* Be a great communicator and natural problem solver
* Stay calm under pressure and work well in a team
* Be resilient, adaptable, and community-focused
**What You’ll Gain**
* Make a real difference where it counts
* Work in a unique and dynamic environment
* Enhance your CV and build valuable skills in law, communication, first aid, self-defence, and more
* Enjoy travel benefits (location dependent)
* Develop personally and explore pathways into full-time policing
* You’ll build transferable skills that will support your career long term; problem-solving, decision-making, leadership, teamwork, and communication. These are skills that stay with you, wherever your career takes you.
* Oyster card for travel

# AI Enablement Consultant
London, England, United Kingdom
## Opportunity
Brunswick is recruiting an **AI Enablement Consultant** to help colleagues across the firm use AI effectively, confidently and responsibly.
The role will help teams identify where AI can add value, redesign workflows and build new ways of working. Working closely with Partners, Directors and teams globally, the successful candidate will turn emerging AI capabilities into practical applications for colleagues and clients.
The AI Enablement team focuses on general-purpose tools, including ChatGPT, and works closely with Brunswick’s AI Lab, which develops proprietary AI tools and provides advanced technical expertise.
## About the Role
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
* Working with teams to identify where AI can improve client and internal work and redesigning workflows accordingly.
* Providing practical guidance on prompting, workflow design and the effective use of approved AI tools.
* Designing and delivering training, workshops and guidance for colleagues with different levels of AI experience.
* Helping colleagues understand AI’s capabilities, limitations and appropriate use.
* Identifying and sharing successful AI workflows, use cases and good practice across the firm.
* Building relationships with AI champions and gathering user feedback to inform training, tools and priorities.
* Testing emerging AI tools and assessing their business value, usability, limitations and risks.
* Working closely with the AI Lab to support adoption of Brunswick-developed tools and connect user needs with product development.
* Travelling to Brunswick offices as required to support teams and local adoption.
## What We're Looking For
The successful candidate will have:
* Strong practical experience using generative AI, particularly ChatGPT, in a professional setting.
* A strong understanding of AI’s capabilities, limitations and business applications.
* The ability to understand workflows and identify where AI could enable better ways of working.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including confidence working with senior stakeholders.
* The ability to translate complex technology into clear, practical guidance.
* Sound judgement around emerging technology, business value and risk.
* A collaborative, curious and hands-on approach, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguity and drive practical change.
Experience in learning and development, change, technology enablement or transformation is highly desirable. Professional services or advisory experience would be advantageous, as would willingness to travel internationally.

Opportunity
Brunswick is accelerating its use of AI to strengthen the advice we give clients and how we operate. We are looking for a Data Architect to join our AI Lab and shape the technical and data foundations that enable us to build and scale proprietary AI products securely and effectively.
This is a hands-on, influential role spanning architecture and practical delivery. You will take a portfolio-wide view of how data, applications, models, APIs and shared components fit together, creating reusable patterns and capabilities that help engineers move faster while maintaining high standards of security, resilience and maintainability.
Working closely with AI Engineers, Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams, you will ensure the Lab has the architecture and underlying platform it needs to innovate at pace while aligning with Brunswick’s wider technology environment.
About the Role
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
Design and evolve the data and technical architecture underpinning the AI Lab’s portfolio of proprietary products.
Define scalable patterns for how applications, data sources, models, APIs and enterprise systems connect and interact.
Design approaches to data modelling, access, storage, movement and governance, particularly for sensitive or business-critical information.
Identify opportunities to create reusable services, components and data capabilities that accelerate development across multiple products.
Establish standards and patterns for data pipelines, APIs, integration, environments, deployment and observability.
Work closely with engineers to translate architectural principles into practical solutions, balancing scalability with rapid prototyping and delivery.
Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams to ensure solutions meet Brunswick’s security, privacy, governance and architectural standards.
Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, reduce duplication and improve interoperability across the firm.
Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.
Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.
What We’re Looking For
You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. You will be comfortable moving between strategic architecture and detailed technical decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs between long-term scalability and speed of delivery. The successful candidate will bring:
6+ years of relevant experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role.
Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.
Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.
Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data warehouses, lakes/lakehouses and governance.
Experience with cloud platforms; Microsoft Azure experience is particularly relevant.
Good working knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering approaches, including Python.
Experience designing reusable technical components, shared services or platforms used across multiple products or teams.
A strong understanding of data governance, security, privacy, lineage and quality, and how these are embedded into architecture and delivery.
An understanding of the data requirements of AI and machine-learning applications, including securely making structured and unstructured enterprise data available to AI solutions.
A good understanding of modern software engineering and SDLC practices, including CI/CD, version control, testing and observability.
Sufficient hands-on technical depth to work credibly with engineers, review designs and contribute to implementation where useful.
Strong judgement and pragmatism, with the ability to balance consistency and reuse with experimentation and speed.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical colleagues.
Desirable experience
Architecting applications or platforms incorporating generative AI, large language models or machine learning.
Designing data and integration architectures for AI applications, including retrieval and grounding approaches.
Building internal developer platforms, shared services or reusable application frameworks.
Working with sensitive enterprise data and complex security or governance requirements.
Experience in professional services, financial services, advisory or another complex enterprise environment.
Why Join Us
Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.
About Brunswick
Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.
Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

Opportunity
Brunswick is accelerating its use of AI to strengthen both the advice we give clients and how we operate. We are looking for an AI Product Manager to join our AI Lab and help identify, design and scale proprietary AI products that enhance how Brunswick works and advises clients.
Sitting at the intersection of AI, product and the business, you will identify high-value opportunities, turn ambiguous ideas into compelling product concepts, and work closely with AI Engineers to bring them to life.
This role is focused specifically on proprietary products developed by the AI Lab. It does not own firmwide adoption, training or enablement for general-purpose AI tools.
As the AI Product Manager, you will own product management across the AI Lab’s portfolio, with a particular focus on discovering and shaping new products and capabilities.
You will work with teams across Brunswick to understand business problems and user needs, identify where bespoke AI can create meaningful value, and translate the strongest opportunities into clear product propositions and requirements.
Acting as the bridge between users and engineers, you will help determine what to build, what not to build and where to focus.
About the Role
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

**The Role**
The Revenue & Projects Team is responsible for ensuring that all administrative activities relating to revenue management and time recording are completed accurately and within required timescales. This function is critical to the organisation, supporting the timely collection of customer payments and the provision of essential management information relating to resource utilisation and expenditure allocation across the CAA.
As part of a wider team, colleagues collectively contribute to customer invoicing, query resolution, support of credit control queries, and the administration of the project tracking process. The team also plays a key role in driving continuous improvement, seeking opportunities to enhance processes, improve service delivery, and increase efficiency across all areas of responsibility.
The R&P Team Leader role is responsible for leading and developing the Revenue & Projects Team, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of all revenue administration, customer invoicing, project coding, and associated support activities. The postholder will oversee the day-to-day operations of the team, ensuring prioritisation of workloads, high standards of customer service, data accuracy, and process compliance are maintained. The postholder will also be responsible for coordinating in a timely manner, customer and invoice queries including liaison with technical teams within the regulatory sector, the funding & Value team, credit control
The role plays a vital part in supporting the organisation's financial management by enabling the timely collection of customer revenue (~£200m) and ensuring the provision of reliable management information relating to resource utilisation and expenditure allocation through project tracking.
The Team Leader will champion continuous improvement, driving efficiencies, enhancing service delivery, and fostering a positive and high-performing team culture.
**Core Accountabilities**
**Leadership and Team Management**
* Lead, motivate and develop the Revenue & Projects Team to deliver a high-quality service.
* Prioritise workloads and resources to ensure SLA objectives and deadlines are consistently achieved.
* Monitor team performance through agreed KPIs and service standards.
* Conduct regular one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and development discussions.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer focus.
* Support training needs and support training gaps, conduct performance reviews, manage team absences, reviewing and prioritising workloads, and resolving any employee issues that arise.
**Revenue Administration and Invoicing**
* Oversee the accurate and timely production of customer invoices in accordance with organisational policies and procedures.
* Ensure income is appropriately recorded and administered.
* Monitor invoice processing activities and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Support the resolution of invoicing issues and customer queries, escalating complex matters to technical experts where appropriate.
**Project Support Administration**
* Ensure the effective administration of the organisation's project code processes.
* Monitor compliance with project code requirements and deadlines and recommend actions on non-compliance
* Actively review on a regular basis the project code database to ensure it reflects required and open project codes
**Customer Service and Stakeholder Management**
* Act as an escalation point for internal and external customer queries as required.
* Develop positive and credible working relationships with stakeholders across SFPR and the wider organisation, including technical experts within the Regulatory sectors.
* Ensure team communications are clear, timely, and customer focused.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues and influence the prompt resolution of issues to improve service delivery.
**C****ontinuous Improvement**
* Lead on the identification, recommendation and implementation of process improvements to increase efficiency, control, and customer satisfaction.
* Review existing procedures and contribute to service improvement initiatives.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to identify and influence changes to improve organisational efficiency and customer experience.
* Support the implementation of new systems, processes, and ways of working.
* Champion innovation and embed a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
**Governance, Controls and Reporting**
* Ensure compliance with relevant financial controls, policies, and procedures.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation supporting audit and assurance requirements.
* Produce and analyse performance and management information to engage with and make recommendations of best practice to budget holders and senior colleagues to support decision-making.
* Ensure robust checking mechanisms are in place for all data input and processing ensuring that they are consistently used.
* Identify and manage operational risks within the team's remit, ensuring data led solutions are identified to mitigate current and future risks.
**About You**
**Essential Knowledge and Experience**
* Experience of leading and developing a team in a finance, revenue, billing, or administrative environment.
* Experience of customer invoicing and revenue administration processes.
* Experience of managing workloads and delivering services within agreed deadlines.
* Experience of handling customer and stakeholder queries effectively.
* Strong understanding of financial controls and data accuracy requirements.
* Experience of implementing process improvements and driving operational efficiencies.
**Essential Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Significant experience of working with large data sets within Microsoft Excel
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent organisational and prioritisation abilities for self and team.
* Flexible working mindset and adaptation to changing priorities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.
* Competent in the use of financial and business systems.
**Desirable**
* Experience of time recording, project tracking systems.
* Continuous Improvement qualification or experience of Lean/process improvement methodologies.
* Financial qualification or relevant professional accreditation.
**Additional Information**
For many appointments within the CAA, these roles require access to operationally sensitive infrastructure and/or Nationally Protected information. For these roles the post holders must undergo National Security Vetting and achieve the appropriate level of clearance.
**SC -** To be vetted we will usually expect a reasonable period of residency in the UK so that meaningful checks can be undertaken. For this role this will need to be 5 years.
**If you do not meet these requirements, we may not be able to accept your application.**

London, United Kingdom
