**Join ICOMAT – Revolutionising the Future of Lightweight Manufacturing!**
iCOMAT is an advanced manufacturing company that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) - the only proven technology for producing defect-free curved-fiber composite parts at industrial scale. We deliver the lightest structures possible for aerospace, automotive, defense, and space, at a rate and cost efficiency that far exceeds existing composite production processes.
We build and operate automated factories for composite materials, delivering components to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs. The business has three main divisions: development of automated production machines, development of software design and production tools, and operation of the factory. We work with 25+ customers and completed the largest ever Series A in composites manufacturing to fuel a significant scale-up, with growth plans that will see the business multiply in size over the next two to three years and expand operations into the UK, Europe and the US.

As Head of Quality you will own quality across iCOMAT: the systems, the standards and the culture behind every part we ship. AS9100 sits at the heart of this role. You will own our AS9100 certification and keep us audit-ready as we scale, building the quality function that delivers defect-free aerospace components from a single UK factory today to multi-site operations across Europe and the US. Owning the Quality Management System end to end: developing, implementing and maintaining it in compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001 and applicable regulations. Leading quality planning for new programmes through FAIR, APQP and PPAP, so every new part enters production with quality built in rather than inspected in.

Setting supplier quality requirements and performance metrics, running supplier audits and evaluations, and following corrective actions through to closure. You will work with Purchasing and Supply Chain to keep suppliers compliant and risk under control.

Building and mentoring quality capability across the business: inspectors, engineers, shop floor personnel and management. You will set a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement, and train the team on the standards, procedures and regulatory requirements that keep us certified.

Acting as the primary quality contact for customers, regulatory agencies and certification bodies. You will support customer audits and quality reviews, and close out complaints, returns and corrective actions with responses that are timely and effective.

# 3D Graphic Designer Jobs
August 25, 2026
There are very few fields as diverse as graphic design, an industry in which no single role is clear cut and jobs often overlap (even with work that isn't graphic design related).
That's exactly what you'll find in our below list of graphic design jobs which we hope will help demystify some of the terms and provide a little bit of guidance as to how to get a graphic design job (as well as what kind of salary to expect once you do).
But it bears repeating: unlike our previous job glossary lists (such as the guides to jobs in film and broadcast journalism), rarely are two individual graphic design jobs alike and there's a lot of crossover between duties. As such, average salaries are given as very rough rules of thumb only.
We've also provided an approximate difficulty scale which indicates not the technical requirements of the job, but how difficult it is to get full time, paid work. Without further ado...
### Print Designer
The debate continues to rage as to whether designing for print is a dying art form (and it is true that jobs in this sector have diminished), but creating artwork that is intended solely for printed materials is still in demand. It's a highly technical field, requiring in-depth knowledge of both traditional print techniques and their integration with contemporary digital advancements.
Print Designer Career Path: While 'print designer' is a blanket term covering a wide number of subsets (such as package designer below), those looking to acquire print design jobs are nearly always required to have attended graphic design school beforehand. Proficiency in the Adobe suit and particularly InDesign Quark Xpress are also essential before hitting the classifieds.
Pros: There's a recognizable feeling of merit to work solely for print these days, and once you've mastered the art, you can tackle pretty much any job in the industry. Regular, 9 to 5 hours are also common.
Cons: The number of print jobs is dwindling rapidly - those working for book, newspaper and periodicals can expect a 16% decrease in jobs between 2012 and 2022 (according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics).
Difficulty: 7/10
Print Designer Salary: The median average is, 000, but the mean average is useless for print design salaries given the variance across the industry.
### Web Designer
Unlike a print designer, a web designer deals specifically in graphic elements intended for viewing on a desktop or mobile device. Given the hugely varied nature of the work that falls into this category, it's a broad term that covers a large swathe of the industry and is often conflated with web development; for the purposes of this entry, we're going to focus specifically on rather than coding.
Web Designer Career Path: While graphic design school and related qualifications can offer a huge step up, a lot of web designers are self-taught and build up their portfolios gradually to score further work. As above, the ability to also code in a variety of language is massively beneficial.
Pros: A reasonable degree of creative control, plus opportunities to work either on a freelance basis or salaried depending on your preference.
Cons: It's an extremely saturated market, so competition is high while the pay is low for what is actually a very skilled job.

Confidence working with evolving requirements, taking ownership and communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Relevant technical experience

You’ll deliver useful capabilities that teams adopt and trust. You’ll improve the reliability, security and maintainability of our products and help establish effective, repeatable ways of building high-quality software with AI.

### Description
MetalBear is **remote-first**, **early-stage, and product-led**. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.
The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.
That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

## **About Mistral**
Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
## **Role Summary**
The Partnerships organization is accelerating its expansion globally. *We now need the architecture to scale our delivery force through partnerships to meet the next wave of enterprise demand.*
This is a high-impact role offering exceptional exposure to the European market, focusing on Northern Europe (UKI & Nordics) and the opportunity to shape our partnership program from the ground up. You will work closely with Partnership & GTM leadership, Partner Solution Architects, and cross-functional teams to drive breakthrough co-sell motions, co-solutions, and joint go-to-market initiatives with strategic and regional partners.
This is a critical hybrid responsibility: Partner management across Europe for Strategic Partners + building regional-flavored partnerships to set up the foundations for future success. In this role, you’ll report directly to the Europe GSI Director and will have functional accountability to our VP Northern Europe, playing a vital role in co-defining and executing our regional go-to-market strategy.
## **What You Will Do**
## **Strategy & Architecture**
* Architect and execute the GSI partner ecosystem model across Northern Europe, establishing high-value frameworks that align enterprise strategic goals with scalable revenue models.
* Define and institutionalize multi-year strategic roadmaps with major German Systems Integrators to accelerate co-selling motions, technical alignment, and joint pipeline expansion.
* Drive ecosystem vision and governance, orchestrating financial growth targets, technical solutions integration, and transformative co-marketing programs.
## **Commercial Velocity**
* Spearhead regional partner-led revenue generation, surpassing growth targets through systematic joint deal acceleration and high-impact GTM execution.
* Establish executive alignment and field resolution standards across partner networks to maximize strategic velocity and eliminate friction in large enterprise deals.
* Build comprehensive performance insights and analytical models to track partnership health, ROI, and long-term ecosystem value creation.
* Scale SI delivery capabilities through specialized enablement programs, ensuring partners become force multipliers for Mistral AI enterprise deployment.
## **Ecosystem Interlock**
* Embed robust co-sell engagement rules, attribution frameworks, and deal registration workflows across the Northern Europe GTM organization to drive Tier 1 opportunity conversion.
* Champion cross-functional collaboration across Solution Architects, Enablement, Marketing, and Product teams to champion seamless partnership delivery and pipeline maturity.
* Lead Monthly Business Reviews and executive synchronization cadences with Northern Europe regional leadership to sustain strategic alignment.
* Provide strategic feedback loops to product and engineering leadership, aligning model evolution and deployment architectures with Northern Europe enterprise needs.

The successful applicants will work closely with the Government Relations and Public Affairs team, as well as colleagues within the Motability Foundation and at Motability Operations, to advance our policy priorities, support the integrated communications strategy, and help raise the profile of issues affecting disabled people in their everyday lives. You will also engage regularly with policymakers and external organisations.
These roles will suit experienced, proactive and collaborative policy professionals who want to strengthen their advocacy experience and help make transport more accessible and inclusive for disabled people.
### What you will be doing:
As a Policy Manager, you will lead policy work across agreed priority areas. This will include:
* Developing robust policy positions, from defining the problem and intended outcomes, to assessing evidence and options, testing discoverability, and making clear recommendations – working closely with colleagues within the Motability Foundation and at Motability Operations, and external stakeholders.
* Drafting high-quality policy outputs, including policy briefings, consultation responses, calls for evidence, and external correspondence.
* Collaborating closely with Communications teams colleagues to promote policy positions to government, public and professional audiences, including contributing to campaign development.
* Tracking political, legislative and policy developments, horizon-scanning for risks and opportunities and adapting policy positions and plans as needed.
* Building trusted external relationships with policymakers, industry stakeholders and others who shape or influence policy – namely, disabled people and Disabled People’s Organisations. You must be comfortable with effectively communicating complex policy positions to a wide range of stakeholders.
* Working collaboratively across the organisation to ensure policy work is aligned and informed by wider insight.
* Contributing to the development of the policy function, including its priorities, ways of working, and culture of collaboration, openness, and continuous improvement.
### ### Your experience:

Where candidates do not have direct experience, they should be able to demonstrate strong policy skills and the ability to apply them quickly to complex issues.

* Strong experience in policy analysis and developing evidence-led and creative policy positions - ideally on high profile and pivotal policy.
* Demonstrable experience of communicating policy to senior officials, Ministers, advisers, Parliamentarians and wider industry stakeholders, both verbally and through high-quality written outputs.
* Strong understanding of UK and devolved policy-making and legislative processes, and strong political acumen and awareness of UK and devolved governments’ priorities.
* Understanding of, or commitment to developing expertise in, disability, accessibility, and inclusive transport policy.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a larger team and a complex matrix organisation, and build effective internal and external relationships.

## About The Role
Leading the design and delivery of customer outcomes insight across MO, you will provide robust evidence that customers understand our products, services and communications and that MO are delivering good outcomes throughout the customer lifecycle.
Working as part of the Customer Insight & Analytics team and reporting to the CX Insight Lead, you will be responsible for designing and delivering a programme of insight and research that supports MO’s Consumer Duty, responsible lending and product governance obligations.
You will lead research into customer outcomes and customer understanding. This will include, but not limited to, reviewing existing HEARTbeat (Voice of Customer real-time feedback) programme, developing customer understanding research programme utilising Headlight Customer Panel and support monitoring and reporting of outcomes initially focused on revised mileage proposition and other areas where there is a foreseeable risk of customer harm.
This will include testing whether customers understand key information such as mileage allowances, potential excess mileage charges, affordability considerations, available support and the actions they can take during their lease.
The postholder will work closely with Legal & Compliance, In-life Customer service and Operation Teams, Finance, Marketing Communications and CX team, Tech teams and wider Customer Insight & Analytics colleagues to bring together customer research, behavioural evidence, operational data and management information. This evidence will be used to assess whether customer communications and interventions are effective, identify emerging risks and recommend improvements.
The postholder will establish repeatable approaches for testing customer understanding before and after communications are introduced. This will include qualitative and quantitative research, comprehension testing, behavioural analysis, surveys and targeted research with customers who may be vulnerable or at greater risk of experiencing poor outcomes.
Key to the role will be to ensure that research findings are translated into clear, timely and actionable insight. The postholder will support the Responsible Lending and Consumer Duty Outcomes Monitoring Framework, product and communication reviews, governance reporting and decisions about customer interventions. As subject-matter expertise on customer understanding and customer-outcome research, the postholder will influence stakeholders to adopt evidence-based approaches and ensuring research remains robust, inclusive and aligned with regulatory expectations. You will support the Head of Customer Insight & Analytics and the Customer Experience Insight Lead in embedding a culture in which customer outcomes are actively monitored, emerging harm is identified early and customer evidence is used to improve products, services, communications and support.
Main responsibilities * Design, deliver and continuously improve MO’s customer outcomes insight programme, ensuring it provides reliable evidence of customer understanding and customer outcomes.
* Lead and deliver customer-understanding testing of key customer communications, including renewal communications, product information, statements of responsibility, mileage warnings, digital content, calculators and customer-support information.
* Assess whether customers understand important product features, potential costs, risks, available choices and the actions they may need to take.
* Develop and maintain a structured programme of pre-launch and post-launch communication testing, using appropriate qualitative, quantitative and behavioural research methods.

# Senior Manager, Internal Communications
London
## **About Nscale**
Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.
We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.
## **The Role**
Nscale is looking for a Senior Manager, Internal Communications to help shape how we communicate, connect and scale as a global business.
Reporting to the VP, Internal Communications, you will shape how we communicate with Nscalers across the employee lifecycle — from the day someone joins, to how their manager talks to them about performance, change and what the company is trying to achieve. Working hand in glove with our People team, you will build the programmes, toolkits and campaigns that turn a fast-growing headcount into a company that actually knows itself.
You will also be our internal communications presence at headquarters and across our regions outside the United States. As our business grows quickly in the US, this role makes sure our teams in the UK, Europe and Asia-Pacific stay informed, visible and part of the story.
Our internal communications team is small, senior and deliberately unstructured. You will own specific areas outright, contribute to areas your colleagues own, and pick up whatever the company needs at a given moment — a last-minute all-hands, a policy that has to land well, a milestone worth celebrating. The scope below is where we expect you to start, not where we expect you to stay. This is a hands-on role: you will set your own plans and then deliver them yourself.
## **What You'll Do**
**Employee Lifecycle & People Communications**
* Own internal communications across the employee lifecycle globally — onboarding, performance cycles, benefits, policy changes and People-led programmes
* Act as the primary communications counterpart to the People team, bringing communications thinking to their programmes early rather than at launch
* Build and run our manager communications layer: cascade toolkits, talking points, FAQ packs and briefing materials that help managers communicate well with their own teams
* Design onboarding communications that work at pace, so new Nscalers understand how we communicate and where to find what they need in their first week
* Develop culture and values communications, storytelling and recognition programmes that reflect who we actually are as we scale
**Regional & Rest-of-World Communications**
* Act as the internal communications lead for the UK, Europe and Asia-Pacific, ensuring our teams outside the US are informed, visible and never last to know
* Be our on-the-ground communications presence at headquarters, with a real feel for what is happening in the building and what people are talking about
* Build standing relationships with regional office leads, site leadership and People partners, and bring what you learn back to the team
* Advise on sequencing and timing so global announcements land sensibly for every region, not just for the US
* Create regional content and support local leadership visibility, including for our sites in Norway and across Europe
**Change Communications**
* Lead communications planning for people-related and regional change, ensuring employees receive timely, consistent and thoughtful information
* Build messaging frameworks and toolkits that enable leaders and managers to communicate change effectively with their teams
* Handle sensitive and high-stakes communications with sound judgment and discretion
**Company Rhythm & Moments**
* Contribute to our company rhythm — all-hands, company updates, newsletters and intranet — with particular focus on making these work for a globally distributed audience
* Support major company moments and events, including coordinating regional participation in global moments
* Draft and shape messaging for senior leaders in your areas of ownership, and partner with leadership across the regions you cover
* Bring strong editorial judgment to everything the team publishes
**Insight & Improvement**
* Track how communications are landing across your programmes and regions, and use what you learn to improve
* Contribute to employee listening, and make sure what matters to teams outside the US is heard and acted on
## **What We're Looking For**
* Significant experience in internal or employee communications, ideally within a technology, high-growth or global business
* Demonstrable experience partnering with People or HR teams on programmes across the employee lifecycle
* Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex topics clear, engaging and relevant
* Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing stakeholders more senior than yourself
* Real experience communicating across multiple countries, cultures and time zones, and a genuine instinct for when a global message will not work locally
* Experience building manager enablement or cascade communications from scratch
* A practical, hands-on approach: comfortable building the plan and then doing the work yourself
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities at pace
* Comfort with ambiguity, shifting priorities and a scope that will change as we grow
*Nice to have: experience in a business with frontline, field or non-desk-based employees; additional languages relevant to our regions.*
## **Our Commitment**
At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.
If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

# Data Protection Assistant (Part-Time)
**Location:** Hybrid/Flexible Working Arrangement **Hours:** 2 days per week, with an additional hours during busy periods as required. Hours can be worked flexibly, although occasional availability during normal office hours will be required for team communications.
## About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and proactive **Data Protection Assistant** to support the Council's data protection responsibilities. This is a hands-on role that will act as the primary liaison with the Council's Data Protection Officer (DPO), providing advice and support regarding potential data protection complaints, breaches, and GDPR compliance matters.
The successful candidate will play a key role in managing Subject Access Requests (SARs), ensuring requests are logged, allocated, processed, and prepared for release in accordance with GDPR requirements.

* Act as the primary point of contact between the Council and the Data Protection Officer (DPO).

* Manage the end-to-end administration of Subject Access Requests (SARs), including:
+ Logging requests.
+ Allocating requests to relevant departments.
+ Monitoring progress and deadlines.
+ Reviewing and processing responses prior to release.
* Support compliance with GDPR, Data Protection legislation, and Council policies.
* Assist in the investigation and reporting of data breaches and information security incidents.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation relating to data protection activities.
* Work collaboratively with departments across the Council to ensure compliance with legislative requirements.
## Essential Requirements
To be successful in this role, you must have:
* Proven experience in a **Data Protection and GDPR-focused role**, ideally within **Local Government**.
* A good working knowledge of:
+ Data Protection legislation and GDPR.
+ The Data Protection Act.
+ Information Security principles and standards, including **BS7799**.
* Experience managing Subject Access Requests and handling confidential information.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet statutory deadlines.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* The ability to work independently and provide practical advice on data protection matters...
*All offers will be subject to satisfactory compliance screening, including right to work in the UK and references. In addition, due to the nature of the role the appropriate level of criminal record disclosure will be undertaken*.

**Location:** London **Starting Salary:** £54,000 + £7,000 signing bonus + annual performance bonus **Available start dates:** September 2027, January 2028, March 2028 (Allocated post-offer) **ABOUT OC&C**
OC&C is a global strategy consulting firm, founded in 1987 in London. We are continuing to expand rapidly and are looking for the most talented graduates to join our growing cohorts in the London office. Our people are agile thinkers from a variety of backgrounds, united by constant curiosity and a desire to work together to solve problems. Each client challenge is unique, so instead of relying on generic solutions, we break down a problem using our philosophy of ‘uncommon sense’ until we find its root. Our London office is looking for Associate Consultants to join the analytics team – a key source of the strategic advice we provide to our clients. As our clients' data is becoming increasingly big and complicated, the need for high quality statistical analysis is growing rapidly. OC&C is regularly tasked with problems where the answers are hidden in large, messy and complex data sets such as transaction data, customer-behaviour data and web data. The analytics practice work as both technical experts and strategy consultants to unearth insights, identify recommendations and communicate them persuasively to our clients. Analytics is therefore an increasingly important part of what OC&C does and growing rapidly as a practice. **WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT**
* **Our strategy and M&A focus** – a lot of consulting is multi-month implementation projects, focused on cost or IT transformation; that’s not us. We provide advice to our clients on where to play and how to win, in our key sectors of Retail, Leisure & Hospitality; Consumer Goods; Technology & Media; B2B Products & Services; and Private Equity. We work with organisations of all sizes, from global blue chips and household names to smaller industry challengers. Due to the strategic nature of our work, we spend a lot more time collaborating together in our London office - we don’t “live out of a suitcase” like some types of consulting.
* **Our people** – at OC&C our people are at the heart of everything we do & we work hard to ensure we are a workplace that encourages everyone to flourish, irrespective of background. Diversity of thought is integral to the success of our business & our six diversity networks play a pivotal role in ensuring we are developing and nurturing everyone.

No client-service industries work the typical 9-5, but we have several mechanisms to make sure the job sustainable, including our popular unpaid leave scheme – over 70% of our Associate Consultants opt to take up to an extra month of unpaid leave every year (as well as fully paid holidays). We’re also encouraged to try new things outside of work with the ‘Hobbies & Wellness’ subsidy & our internal ‘Ministry of Fun’ takes their job of organising social events very seriously!

We devote a portion of our revenue to pro-bono projects each year, we help clients with ESG issues, and we take ethics seriously, ensuring that you don’t work on projects that are against your values. We are also incredibly proud to be a B Corp.
* **Our global opportunities** - we deliver insights to clients across the globe and many of our projects have cross-office teams. As you progress there will also be opportunities such as ambassadorships, which offer people a chance to work abroad for 4-6 months, or longer-term transfers.
## About The Candidate
**WH****AT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
* **Logical and analytical thinkers** who enjoy working with datasets and statistics, can interpret quantitative information and use it to solve complex problems and draw meaningful insights
* **Experience with one or more programming languages – Python is** **required**
* **A strong academic record**, ideally with a degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field
* **Curious and structured problem-solvers** who can identify what matters most, think critically about assumptions and evidence, and are comfortable working through ambiguity
* **Commercially curious individuals** who are interested in understanding business problems and turning analysis into practical recommendations – no previous business experience is required
* **Clear and confident communicators** who can explain complex ideas and analytical findings logically and accessibly, both verbally and in writing
* **Collaborative team players** who build strong relationships, value different perspectives and are open to feedback
* **Proactive and adaptable learners** who take ownership of their work, show initiative and are keen to learn quickly and apply new knowledge
* **Motivated,** **resilient** **and hard-working individuals** who are always keen to get to the best answer
**Right to Work in the UK:** Successful candidates must have the right to work in the UK by the time they join. We have a limited number of visa sponsorships available for this graduate role. Sponsorship will be considered for eligible candidates who require it, subject to availability and business requirements. **HOW TO APPLY**
At OC&C are committed to fostering an inclusive culture, in which people of all backgrounds can thrive. We encourage applications from all, regardless of age, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression, transgender status, disability, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, religion or belief, race or ethnic origin, and socioeconomic background. We also have network groups who actively support the inclusion of all our colleagues. We ask that all candidates remove their name and contact information from their CV before submitting alongside their application. **Please note, due to the technical nature of this role, there will be a ‘coding test’ as part of the recruitment process, however, only basic coding ability is** **required.**
OC&C is a Disability Confident Committed Employer – if you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, please include this information in the relevant section of your application form and we will work with you to accommodate these. Please also make sure that any correspondence from OC&C Strategy Consultants is included on your email providers safe sender list, as occasionally candidates have missed communication from us when emails have been directed into their junk folder. **THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS** 1. **CV Submission – *Please remove name & contact details. (No cover letter* *required)***
2. **Online Blended Assessment -** Combines numerical and critical reasoning questions alongside behavioural and motivational questions, to help us understand your skills and approach to problem-solving.
3. **Online one-way video Assessment -** Candidates who are successful at the blended assessment will then be invited to complete a short one-way video assessment.
4. **Online Python Coding Test**
5. **1st Round Interviews -** 2 x 30-minute virtual interviews with Analytics Team
6. **2nd** **Round Interviews** - 2 x 45-minute in-person case study interviews with Associate Partners & Partners
7. **Job Offer!**

Manager, Corporate Actuarial (FCIA), Actuarial Analytics & Insights
****Job Description****
The Actuarial Analytics & Insights, S&R team forms part of the Corporate Actuarial (CA) function within Divisional Business Services (DBS) and is responsible for the Savings and Retirement (S&R) business. The S&R Line of Business delivers funded and non-funded reinsurance solutions to global insurance clients, catering for the increasing demand from clients in various jurisdictions for innovative reinsurance support that can transfer both longevity and asset risk.
The team are responsible for performing analysis and communicating insights in relation to both the in-force book and new business. This includes working across US GAAP, US Statutory (US STAT), Internal Economic Capital (EC) and Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) reporting bases, as well as any applicable local reporting bases. The team’s focus is on developing a deep understanding of both the asset and liability side of the balance sheets, delivering value-add outcomes that support S&R and wider PL Re’s strategic priorities.
The team will interact closely with S&R and will be a key part of DBS and PL Re, interacting with CA (including the Valuation team and Actuarial Systems Team), Operations, Finance, R&D, and Pricing.
**The Role**
Based in Bermuda, we have an exciting opportunity for an individual with a strong actuarial background and relevant experience to join the Corporate Actuarial function as a Manager, focusing on BMA requirements for the Savings & Retirement (S&R) business.
Reporting to the AVP, Actuarial Analytics & Insights, S&R, this role offers a challenging variety of work, exposure to senior management and excellent opportunities to make positive contributions to S&R and CA. The role requires a good understanding of the Bermuda regulatory frameworks, particularly in respect of the Scenario-Based Approach (SBA) and Bermuda Solvency Capital Requirement (BSCR), as the successful individual will play a key role in overseeing BMA requirements from an S&R perspective. This role would be responsible for ensuring ongoing compliance with the BMA regulations and work closely with the rest of the reporting team to ensure regulatory reporting is submitted in an accurate and timely fashion. This role would also be responsible for overseeing ongoing SBA applications which will require strong technical understanding and communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics to a wide range of audiences.
As part of this role, you will work with other functions within DBS and work with other Corporate Actuarial teams across Pacific Life. Similarly, you will work closely with the S&R Line of Business team, contributing to PL Re’s success in what is a growing and dynamic marketplace. It is also expected that you will have a strong presence in Bermuda, creating a network that allows you to keep abreast of industry and regulatory updates.
**Role Responsibilities**
* Oversee BMA requirements impacting the S&R line of business, including regulatory reporting, supervisory expectations, and emerging regulatory developments.
* Lead and coordinate the preparation, review, and submission of BMA applications, including SBA applications, and other regulatory approvals as required.
* Monitor and interpret changes to BMA rules, guidance, consultation papers, and industry developments, assessing impacts on the S&R business and driving implementation of necessary changes.
* Coordinate responses to BMA requests, regulatory inquiries, thematic reviews, and information requests, ensuring submissions are accurate, comprehensive, and delivered on schedule.
* Provide subject matter expertise on Bermuda regulatory requirements, including capital, solvency, reporting, governance, and risk management expectations applicable to the S&R business.
* Support the assessment and implementation of new products, reinsurance structures, longevity transactions, derivative strategies, and other initiatives from a Bermuda regulatory perspective.
* Prepare management updates and briefing materials for senior leadership on regulatory developments, key risks, approval requirements, and strategic implications for the business.
* Build relationships with stakeholders in S&R and wider DBS, keeping S&R Corporate Actuarial aware of relevant updates.
* Support non-BAU activities and other corporate actuarial projects, as required.
* Act as the S&R regulatory "eyes and ears" in Bermuda, proactively identifying regulatory trends, emerging issues, and industry developments that may impact business strategy, capital management, product design, or reporting requirements.
* Lead and mentor team members, fostering technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and a strong control environment within the reporting function.
**Skills & Experience**
* Qualified actuary with minimum of 5 years’ experience in life insurance or life reinsurance
* Knowledge of Bermuda regulatory frameworks, including the Insurance Act, Economic Balance Sheet (EBS), BSCR, and SBA frameworks.
* Experience preparing or supporting regulatory submissions, approvals, and reporting to the Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA).
* Strong understanding of regulatory capital, solvency, and reporting requirements applicable to life and annuity insurers.
* Experience interpreting and implementing regulatory changes and assessing their impact on business operations, capital, and financial reporting.
* Familiarity with reinsurance structures, longevity transactions, derivatives, asset-intensive business, or pension risk transfer transactions is highly desirable.
* Experience interacting with regulators, external advisors, auditors, and industry bodies.
* Direct experience engaging with the BMA on SBA applications, EBS/BSCR reporting, model approvals, material transactions, or supervisory reviews.
* Experience with annuity reinsurance, funded reinsurance, longevity swaps, asset-intensive reinsurance, or capital optimization initiatives.
* Experience supporting international operations or working across multiple jurisdictions.
* Existing relationships within the Bermuda insurance industry and regulatory community.
* Experience leading reporting process improvement, automation, or transformation initiatives.
**Competencies and Behaviours**
* Strong analytical, problem solving and communication skills
* Ability to work on own initiative and pro-actively manage a varied and demanding workload
* Detail-oriented with the ability to work to timelines
* Proven ability to work with other functions, developing and maintaining working relationships with all parties

# Hydrologist

At Pennon Group, we’re proud to serve communities while protecting the environment. Together with our subsidiaries, South West Water, Bristol Water, Bournemouth Water, SES Water, Pennon Water Services and Pennon Power, we’re leading the way in water and renewables.

Whether you’re starting out or seeking a new challenge, our scale and ambition create opportunities for you to shape your own career.
Ready to make a splash? **Join our team today.**
## Role Purpose
The Hydrologist is responsible for providing specialist hydrological expertise to support water resource management, environmental compliance, and strategic planning activities across the organisation's operating regions. The role leads hydrological assessments and investigations that underpin key statutory programmes, including the Water Industry National Environment Programme (WINEP), Water Resource Management Plans (WRMP), and Drought Plans.
Acting as the organisation's expert client for hydrology, the postholder will analyse, interpret and communicate hydrological data and modelling outputs to assess environmental impacts, support water resource decision-making, and ensure compliance with environmental regulations and licence requirements. The role supports operations across Bournemouth Water, Bristol Water, South West Water (including the Isles of Scilly), and SES Water.
## Key Responsibilities
### Hydrological Leadership & Expertise
* Provide technical hydrological leadership and advice for key statutory programmes including WINEP, WRMP and Drought Plan development.
* Act as the subject matter expert for hydrology and hydrometry across water resources activities.
* Support environmental and water resource planning decisions through robust hydrological analysis and interpretation.
* Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, abstraction licences, permits and industry best practice.
### Hydrological Assessment & Analysis
* Undertake hydrological assessments associated with new and varied abstraction licence applications.
* Analyse the impacts of licence conditions, hands-off flows and abstraction regimes on water availability and environmental outcomes.
* Support drought permit applications and strategic drought planning activities.
* Deliver naturalised and de-naturalised flow assessments to support hydro-ecological modelling and environmental investigations.
* Undertake flow assessments to support fisheries and ecological studies.
* Support operational abstraction compliance monitoring and reporting.
### Data Management & Modelling
* Manage, maintain and improve naturalised flow models and associated analytical tools.
* Analyse and interpret hydrometric and environmental datasets to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Apply rainfall-runoff methodologies and hydrological modelling tools to support water resource assessments.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations to support operational and strategic decision-making.
### Hydrometry & Monitoring
* Support the design and delivery of hydrometric monitoring programmes and solutions.
* Review and develop stage-discharge rating curves where required.
* Assess flow measurement techniques, hydrological monitoring systems and data quality standards.
* Ensure monitoring activities provide robust evidence for regulatory and operational purposes.
### Stakeholder & Consultancy Management
* Build effective working relationships with regulators, including Environment Agency hydrology teams.
* Discuss modelling methodologies, hydrological assessments and monitoring approaches with external stakeholders.
* Specify, manage and review work undertaken by external hydrological consultants.
* Prepare scopes of work and evaluate consultant proposals and tenders.
## Person Specification
### Essential Knowledge & Experience
* Strong understanding of catchment hydrology and water resources management.
* Experience undertaking hydrological assessments, analysis and technical reviews.
* Experience analysing and interpreting hydrometric datasets.
* Ability to produce high-quality technical reports and present complex information clearly.
* Experience supporting low flow studies, drought assessments and water resource investigations.
### Technical Skills
* Hydrological assessment and catchment analysis.
* Hydrometric monitoring and flow measurement.
* Stage-discharge rating curve development and review.
* Rainfall-runoff modelling and hydrological forecasting.
* Technical report writing and stakeholder communication.
* Data analysis and interpretation.
* Project management and prioritisation.
* Analytical problem solving.
### Desirable Experience
* Use of hydrological modelling packages such as GR6J and Qube.
* Programming and analytical tool development using R or Python.
* Experience with GIS software and spatial analysis.
* Knowledge of groundwater-dominated catchments and regional hydrological characteristics.
* Experience working within the water industry environment.
* Hydrometric knowledge, including flow measurement techniques and monitoring infrastructure.

### Essential
* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, Earth Sciences, Physical Geography or another relevant analytical discipline.
* Full UK Driving Licence.

* Master's Degree in a relevant subject.
* Minimum five years' experience delivering hydrological studies and catchment assessments.

# **About Plasma**
Plasma is building the primary account for global money.
Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.
Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.
Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.
The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.
## ## **The Team &** **Our Story**
We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.
We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.
* **Consumer** owns the core Plasma One product experience - onboarding, activation, retention, rewards, tiers, trading, earn, and account management. The team is responsible for growing funded users, engagement, balances, spend, and long-term retention.
* **Payments** owns the financial infrastructure that powers Plasma - accounts, ledgers, funding, payouts, card issuing, reconciliation, payment orchestration, and currency/rail integrations. The team is responsible for the reliability, scalability, and economics of moving and storing money.
* **Business** owns the Plasma experience for companies - the operating account for businesses that work globally: onboarding, receiving, holding, and sending money across borders, corporate cards and spend management, and the roles and approvals that keep teams in control of company money. The team is responsible for taking the product from its first business customers to general availability, and for growing the businesses that run on Plasma.
## **The Role**
We're looking for a staff+ engineer, backend-leaning but comfortable full-stack, to join one of Plasma's engineering teams and take ownership of that team's hardest technical problems. Our stack is TypeScript across the board - Node.js on the backend and React + React Native for the frontend
You are expected to set technical direction for your team's most critical systems, while partnering with product and, where relevant, other teams at the points where your systems connect.
## **The Work**
* Own the hardest technical problems inside your team end to end - the ones that need deep judgment, not just execution.
* Set technical direction for your team's core systems: architecture, data models, and standards that hold up as the team scales.
* Design for reliability first: idempotency, consistency, and graceful failure recovery in systems that move or store real money, or that the network depends on.
* Go deep on the backend, but stay full-stack, own the TypeScript service and the data model, and work through the client or API layer when the problem calls for it.
* Define how your team's systems handle the hard edge cases: partial failures, retries, timeouts, reversals, reconciliation gaps - whatever “correct under pressure” means for your team.
* Contribute, architect and improve the frontend systems and integrations wherever necessary
* Raise the technical bar within your team: code standards, testing strategy, monitoring, incident response, and how the team approaches ambiguous problems.
* Mentor other engineers and drive technical clarity on the hardest parts of your team's system.
## **The Bar**
* A staff-level, hands-on engineer with a track record of owning production systems end to end, not just contributing to them.
* Backend-leaning but full-stack: deep expertise building backend services in TypeScript (Node.js), with enough range to work through the client layer when needed.
* Strong instincts around reliability and correctness - you think in systems: state machines, data integrity, observability, operational risk.
* Comfortable taking systems from zero to one, and then scaling them without losing clarity.
* Strong judgment on tradeoffs: speed vs. safety, abstraction vs. control, simplicity vs. flexibility.
* You communicate clearly, write clean code, and can lead through technical decisions without needing to manage people.
* You have very high agency and don’t wait to be told a problem to work on and proactively find new problems to solve
* You make decisions based on data and use data to ground whether solutions work
## **Nice to have**
* Fintech, banking, or crypto-native background.
* Familiarity with stablecoins, custody, settlement, and blockchain transaction lifecycles.
* You’ve been a founder or early employee at a fast-paced, high agency startup
## **What's in it for you**
* Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.
* A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.
* Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.
* Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.
* All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.
* Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

# Supply Chain Planner- Consumables
Oxford
**Job Overview**
The **Supply Chain Planner – Consumables** is responsible for demand and supply planning, inventory management and material availability across Refeyn's Consumables portfolio. The role ensures materials and finished goods are available to meet production and customer demand whilst maintaining appropriate inventory levels and supporting the continued growth and development of the Consumables business.
Working closely with Manufacturing, Warehouse, Quality, Sales, R&D and external manufacturing partners, the role owns Consumables planning parameters, MRP execution, purchase order management and supply planning, identifying and resolving material and capacity constraints before they impact operations.
The role also provides Supply Chain support during New Product Introduction (NPI) and product transfer, working with the Senior Supplier Quality Engineer on supplier qualification and quality-related activities.
***This position is primarily based at our Botley (Oxford) site, with a minimum on-site requirement of four days per week. You will also be expected to travel occasionally to our Littlemore site as business needs require.***
**Responsibilities**
**Demand & Supply Planning**
* Develop and maintain demand and supply plans for Refeyn's Consumables portfolio.
* Translate demand requirements into material, inventory and capacity plans.
* Maintain ERP/MRP planning parameters including lead times, order policies, re-order points and safety stock.
* Analyse demand, inventory and supply data to identify shortages, excess inventory, capacity constraints and supply risks.
* Develop mitigation plans with relevant stakeholders before constraints impact production or customer supply.
* Ensure appropriate inventory levels are maintained whilst balancing supply continuity, shelf-life requirements and working capital.
* Manage day-to-day inventory activities, including stock adjustments, stock takes, inventory investigations and discrepancy resolution.
* Manage Vendor Replenishment / Supply Key Input into Inventory Agreements (VRMA) internally and in collaboration with suppliers.
**Supply & Purchasing**
* Raise and manage purchase orders for approved Consumables materials, components and services.
* Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively resolve shortages, delays and supply discrepancies.
* Work with suppliers and CMOs to align production schedules, material requirements and capacity with Refeyn demand.
* Monitor batch, lot, shelf-life and expiry requirements in collaboration with Quality and Warehouse teams.
* Escalate significant supplier commercial, contractual or capacity issues.
* Support and as needed lead supplier negotiations, including on price, lead time and terms, as part of the purchasing process.
**SIOP & Forecasting**
* Represent Consumables within the SIOP process, translating demand forecasts into material, inventory and capacity requirements.
* Work closely with Sales and relevant commercial teams to understand changes in demand and assess their impact on supply.
* Identify material, inventory and capacity constraints early and develop appropriate mitigation plans.
* Develop and monitor relevant KPIs including forecast accuracy, inventory, supplier delivery and material availability.
**New Product Introduction & Product Transfer**
* Provide Supply Chain planning support throughout NPD/NPI and product transfer activities.
* Establish planning parameters and ERP/MRP master data for new Consumables materials, components and products.
* Work closely with R&D and Product Engineering to understand future material and supply requirements.
* Work with the Contracts & Strategic Sourcing Manager to ensure new supplier and sourcing requirements are identified early within NPI and appropriately transitioned into operational planning.
* Work with the Senior Supplier Quality Engineer and Quality team to support supplier onboarding, qualification and quality requirements from a Supply Chain perspective.
* Ensure appropriate material and supply plans are established ahead of transfer into routine production.
* Support BOM and item set-up in the ERP system for new Consumables product lines (e.g. Proteins portfolio).
**Supplier & Quality Support**
* Monitor supplier delivery performance and support ongoing supplier performance reviews.
* Support the Senior Supplier Quality Engineer and Quality team in resolving supplier quality issues by assessing material availability, inventory exposure and supply continuity impact.
* Support supplier onboarding and qualification activities from a planning and operational Supply Chain perspective.
* Ensure quality issues and supplier disruptions are appropriately reflected within material and production plans.
* As required manage and develop supplier relationships through regular communication and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
* Manage and follow up on CRB (Change/Corrective Request Board) tickets, ensuring issues are tracked, resolved and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
**Cross-functional Supply Chain Support**
* Share knowledge, workload and best practice across Instruments and Consumables, providing mutual support and operational cover as business priorities require.
* Support planning and purchasing activities across the wider Refeyn portfolio during periods of increased workload, absence or changing operational priorities.
* Identify opportunities to standardise MRP, inventory and planning processes across Instruments and Consumables.
* Maintain sufficient cross-training and understanding of the Instruments supply chain to provide effective operational support when required.
* Support the Process Engineering team with new-generation component transitions, tracking phase-out of old-design components and maintaining visibility of expected run-out / end-of-life dates.
* Work closely with Logistics and Account/Commercial teams to ensure supply plans remain aligned to customer and delivery requirements.
**Continuous Improvement**
* Drive continuous improvement of Consumables planning, inventory and purchasing processes.
* Use ERP/MRP data and analytical tools to improve planning accuracy and Supply Chain performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve inventory efficiency, lead times, supplier delivery performance and working capital.
* Support improvements in planning processes as Consumables volumes and product complexity increase.
* Support Finance with supplier invoicing or billing enquiries relating to Consumables where required.
* Maintain and update ERP (e.g. NetSuite) master data on an ongoing basis to ensure data accuracy.
* Support MRP system/project implementation, incorporating relevant data and processes from the Electronic Quality Management System (EQMS).
**Candidate Requirements**
**Qualifications**
* CIPS Level 3 or above, or equivalent qualification in Business, Procurement or Supply Chain Management, desirable.
* APICS/ASCM CPIM certification or equivalent planning qualification desirable.
* Degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience in a Supply Chain planning role within a manufacturing or technology environment.
**Knowledge & Experience**
**Advanced**
* Demand and supply planning.
* MRP/ERP systems.
* Inventory management and optimisation.
* Forecasting and analytical skills.
* Production and material planning.
**Working Knowledge**
* CMO / contract manufacturing planning.
* Batch, lot, shelf-life and expiry-controlled materials.
* NPD/NPI and product transfer.
* Quality-managed manufacturing environments such as ISO 9001.
* Supplier performance management.
* Purchasing and purchase order management.
**Desirable**
* Experience of NetSuite or comparable ERP/MRP systems.
* Experience within Consumables, Life Sciences, Medical Device or another regulated/high-quality manufacturing environment.
We know there is no such thing as the perfect candidate and that there is great value in transferrable skills, so please don’t feel you have to tick all of the above boxes to apply!
**Why work for Refeyn?**
Compensation and core benefits
* We anticipate a salary starting from **£37,000** per annum for this role, depending on the candidate’s experience.
* 25 days annual leave per year in addition to bank holidays
* Up to 7% employer matched pension contribution
* Private health insurance from day one plus critical illness cover, income protection and life insurance
* Give as You Earn and Cycle to Work salary sacrifice schemes.
Family Friendly Benefits
Refeyn offers the Enjoy Benefits Nursery Scheme to employees after 3 months, and new parents can benefit from up to 17 weeks fully paid maternity, adoption and shared parental leave, 4 weeks fully paid paternity leave, plus an annual allowance for emergency childcare.
Supporting your Development
All employees receive access to LinkedIn Learning which offers thousands of courses to support their personal and professional development. We also run frequent training sessions on both hard and soft skills.
**Refeyn is proud to use anonymised hiring practices. Identifying information such as a candidate's name, email address, date of birth and photo will not be visible to the hiring manager when they review CVs.**

## Description
### **What We Can Achieve Together:**
The Resilient Watersheds Project Manager, Europe (RWPME), manages and advances watershed-scale nature-based solution (NbS) projects that support TNC’s conservation strategy in Europe. The RWPME reports to the Resilient Watersheds Program Director, Europe, and works closely with conservation and policy teams across Europe, as well as TNC’s global community of freshwater NbS practitioners.
Externally the RWPME serves as a key point of contact between the Resilient Watersheds Programme in Europe and partners developing and delivering projects on the ground. The role aligns TNC expertise, resources and networks with partner needs, coordinates TNC’s engagement across multiple projects, establishes timelines and ensures the successful delivery of agreed activities.
This means operating within a matrix of European and global TNC teams while retaining responsibility for coordinating TNC Europe budgets, tracking project performance and reporting outcomes against TNC objectives and grant agreement requirements. The role also contributes expertise and insight to support the Programme Director in developing strategies, plans and products that engage donors, businesses and policymakers, helping to grow the impact and reach of the programme.
### **We’re Looking for You:**
If you’re ready to step into a rapidly evolving programme that works at the intersection of water security, nature conservation and land management – this is the role for you. No two projects are the same so you will need to be creative in applying your knowledge and ready to work with others to solve real world problems. You’ll be joining a small but dynamic team and given opportunities to grow you knowledge and skills on projects that span from the local to global.
### **What You’ll Bring:**
* Bachelor’s degree and 3 years experience in natural resource management or similar field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Relationship-building experience in working closely with a variety of partners, i.e., media, government officials, and internal scientists.
* Experience completing tasks independently concerning timeline(s).
* Experience with communication via written, spoken and graphical means in English and other relevant languages.
* Experience using common software applications such as Word, Excel, web browsers, etc.
* Experience in training.
* Must have valid driver’s license.
### **Desired Qualifications**
* Multi-lingual skills, particularly French & Spanish and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience appreciated.
* 3-5 years’ experience in practice or policy of water and land management , or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Familiarity with principles of Nature based Solutions,.
* Knowledge of ecological watershed management principles.
* Knowledge of current trends and practices in conservation, water management and environmental economics.
### Who We Are:
The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.
One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”
### What We Bring:
Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!
TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

* Good working knowledge and understanding of computer systems specifically MS Office suite software

and flavor. We are market savvy and visionary. We are problem solvers. And we

# Senior Waste Proactive Controller
At Severn Trent, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Help us stay one step ahead as our new Senior Proactive Controller!

* Use data, incident learning and operational insight to identify trends, emerging risks and opportunities for earlier intervention across wastewater assets.

* Support and mentor colleagues, sharing knowledge, developing capability within the team and providing leadership cover when required.
* Work closely with innovation and improvement teams to explore new technologies, processes and ways of working that help deliver better outcomes for customers and the environment.
***What You'll Bring***
* Strong knowledge of wastewater assets, operations and the challenges involved in maintaining network and treatment site performance.
* Experience using telemetry systems, operational data and analytical thinking to investigate issues and identify solutions.
* The ability to make confident decisions, often with limited information, while remaining calm and organised under pressure.
* A track record of influencing stakeholders, building relationships and driving positive action across teams.
* Experience developing processes, reporting, management information or continuous improvement initiatives.
* A passion for coaching, training and developing others, with previous experience supporting or leading a team.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
* Great attention to detail, a proactive mindset and a desire to continually improve how things are done.
***Ideally, You'll Also Have***
* Operational experience working with wastewater assets.
* A full UK driving licence.
* GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths, although we're more interested in your skills, experience and potential.
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**
Working here isn’t just a job. You can build a career at Severn Trent, and we’ll reward you for it too. We have a range of benefits that recognise great work, and award-winning training to help you reach your potential. And we’ll also help you play your part in looking after the environment and the communities where we live. * Help shift Internal Communications from a reactive, news-driven function to one that proactively finds and tells the story of what Shawbrook does.

**About the Linux Behavioural Engine team**
The Linux Behavioural Engine team builds the runtime detection capability that protects Linux servers, workloads and containers. Our engine watches process, file, network and kernel-level activity as it happens, correlates it into meaningful behaviour, and decides in real time whether something is benign or an attack in progress.
That means we live close to the kernel, across a wide spread of distributions, kernel versions and deployment shapes bare metal, VMs, containers and managed Kubernetes. Getting this right at scale is as much a testing and infrastructure problem as it is a detection problem: a change that behaves perfectly on Ubuntu 24.04 may behave very differently on a hardened RHEL kernel or inside a locked-down EKS node.
We are a small, autonomous team that owns its own CI, its own test estate and its own quality bar. It is a good place to broaden quickly. You will get exposure to CI, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and low-level Linux security in one role, with senior engineers close at hand to learn from.
### Role Summary
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test to help run and grow the automated testing and test infrastructure behind the Linux Behavioural Engine.

The other is building: adding new test pipelines, writing new automated tests, and extending coverage into areas we cannot currently reach.
You will work on well-defined pieces of this independently and take on larger design work alongside more senior engineers, with the expectation that your scope grows as you get to know the system. **This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys automation and infrastructure and wants to go deeper on both.**

* Investigate flaky tests and unreliable infrastructure, get to the actual cause, and fix it rather than retrying around it.
* Help instrument CI so the team can see build health, duration trends and failure patterns without digging.

# About the role
At Sulzer, we are innovators with a rich engineering heritage and a future‐focused mindset. To strengthen our Services business across Europe & Africa (EUA), we are looking for a senior engineering leader to drive innovation, technical excellence, and commercial impact across **Steam Turbines and Compressors (STC)**.
As a key member of the **STC Team**, you will develop and lead the engineering innovation and technical strategy for **Compressors**. You will strengthen engineering capabilities across the region, introduce best‐practice technical processes, and support service growth through high‐quality repair, retrofit, and reverse‐engineering solutions.
This is a high‐impact, regionally accountable role combining **deep technical leadership, commercial awareness, and strong stakeholder engagement**.
**Your main tasks and responsibilities**
* **Lead engineering strategy & innovation** for Compressors within Services Europe and Africa.
* Build strong relationships and coordinate support from **global Sulzer specialist engineering teams** and selected external partners.
* Develop and grow **engineering competencies** required to support current and future service business needs.
* Identify **technical risks and commercial opportunities** related to STC repair, retrofit, and upgrade solutions.
* Identify capability gaps and create actionable **resource and development plans** to address them.
* Establish and implement **best**‐**practice engineering processes** to ensure quality, safety, and compliance standards are consistently met.
* Support and guide **reverse**‐**engineering activities** with local and regional engineering teams.
* Technical excellence, quality, and engineering governance across Compressors in Services EUA.
* Influencing engineering standards, processes, and innovation priorities aligned with Sulzer’s global strategy.
**Competencies & behaviours required**
To succeed in this role, you will demonstrate:
* Strong **technical leadership** and credibility with senior engineers and customers.
* Excellent **communication, influencing, and negotiation skills**.
* Proven **relationship**‐**building and stakeholder management** ability across global matrix organisations.
* High **commercial acumen** with cost awareness and customer focus.
* Ability to **act independently**, prioritise effectively, and manage complex workloads.
* Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic service‐driven environment.
* Strong **organisational skills** with attention to detail and quality standards.
**Qualifications, experience & knowledge required**
* Degree in Engineering (or HNC with extensive relevant engineering experience).
* **Minimum 15 years’ experience** with a rotating equipment OEM or service provider.
* **At least 10 years’ experience** in fundamental design of steam turbines and/or centrifugal compressors **>10 MW**.
* Strong knowledge of **relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements**.
* Proven experience in **component design, reverse engineering, analysis, and manufacturing** related to steam turbines and/or centrifugal compressors.
* Experience supporting service, repair, retrofit, and aftermarket environments is highly advantageous.
# What we offer you
* A senior technical leadership role with **regional impact and global visibility**.
* The opportunity to shape Sulzer’s **engineering strategy and innovation agenda** within the Steam Turbines and Compressors BU
* Exposure to complex, high‐value customer challenges across the EUA region.
* A collaborative, engineering‐driven culture focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Strong career development opportunities within a global industrial leader.
Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.
We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

# Audit Senior

As a key front-facing member of the Audit team, yourability to build strong working relationships and effectively implement our audit plans, projects and initiatives will be crucial to our success in enabling our clients to safeguard their controls and compliance and ultimately add commercial value to their businesses. **This role will require travel to client sites, including locations within the Scottish Borders.**
## Key Responsibilities
* Collaborate with management to develop audit plans considering organisational objectives, risks, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct risk assessments to identify areas of potential concern or non-compliance.
* Help to shape our audit procedures and testing methodologies to ensure we maintain a connected and consistent management approach to our audit practice and coverage.
* Lead and supervise audit juniors during fieldwork, ensuring we meet our timelines and quality standards.
* Analyse audit findings, identify any weaknesses or risks with internal controls and provide actionable recommendations.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with clients by fully understanding their business processes and industry specific challenges.

* Review and sign off documentation completion for accuracy and compliance with professional audit standards, providing feedback to juniors as appropriate.
* Create a positive and inclusive working environment for junior auditors, promoting knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and teamwork throughout each assignment.
* Maintain up to date knowledge of the latest accounting and auditing standards, regulations, and industry best practices.
* Apply your technical knowledge to assess the appropriateness of accounting treatments and financial disclosures.
* Continuously enhance professional skills through learning and development, certifications, and self-directed learning.
* Act as an Audit ambassador with your general practice colleagues and new junior employees joining the firm.
* Where risks are identified that can be mitigated through the firm’s services, encourage clients to invest in these services to support their commercial improvement.
* Help with marketing events and activities and network to develop relationships with potential audit clients.
* Participate in quarterly audit committee meetings designed to continually improve the audit experience for both clients and the audit team.

* Hold a professional qualification (ACCA, ACA, ICAS, or similar)
* Experience within a similar role
* Manage work and performance of junior members of the team
* Communicate in a professional, clear and concise way
* Collaborate effectively with others

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.
You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.
The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.
In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.
This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

**We expect you to have:** * 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.

**It will be an added bonus if you have:** * Domain experience in market intelligence, news, financial research, or another data-heavy industry.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to design, build and maintain client websites, Shopify stores and custom web applications.

Apply through this advert, or email your CV to **hello@techvibesit.com** with the subject line **Senior Full Stack Developer Application**.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.
